_about: Founding documents of the United States as Project Gutenberg's early etexts give them: the Mayflower Compact (1620), Patrick Henry's Liberty or Death speech (1775), the Declaration of Independence (1776), the Constitution (1787) and the Bill of Rights (1791). The Federalist is held elsewhere; Lincoln's speeches are on the `lincoln` shelf. Several authors: each item names the words it must show. Added from the classical reading lists (Classical Conversations, Canon Press, New Saint Andrews, Logos School/Online, Bethlehem College & Seminary, Memoria Press, CiRCE): docs/reading-lists/READING-LISTS.tsv.

founding-liberty-or-death: Give Me Liberty or Give Me Death (Patrick Henry, 1775)
founding-declaration: The Declaration of Independence of the United States of America (1776)
founding-bill-of-rights: The United States Bill of Rights (1791)
